fact: The Hivos EUSEE Eswatini Country Focus Report 2026, covering August 2025 to June 2026, found no evidence of a nationwide shutdown of the internet or social media in the period, and records that former MP Dube was released on 5 November 2025 under a royal pardon that bars him from speaking to the press or using social media.
title: Eswatini Country Focus Report 2026
